decks.notes: This Eldrazi Aggro deck focuses on quickly getting powerful Eldrazi creatures onto the battlefield by utilizing mana acceleration and disruption spells. It aims to overwhelm opponents with a combination of aggressive threats like Reality Smasher and Thought-Knot Seer, while also using cards like Chalice of the Void and Wasteland to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck's key strategy is to have a fast start and put pressure on the opponent early, utilizing the Eldrazi's large bodies and disruptive abilities to quickly close out the game.

This Legacy deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's game plan while pressuring them with aggressive creatures. By running a combination of counterspells, hand disruption, and removal spells, it aims to control the board and protect its threats. The deck utilizes efficient creatures like Nethergoyf and Murktide Regent to quickly close out the game. With a mix of tempo plays and card advantage engines like Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student, the deck aims to apply constant pressure while disrupting the opponent's strategy. Additionally, the deck includes Wasteland and Orcish Bowmasters to further disrupt the opponent's mana base.

This deck focuses on quickly establishing a board presence with aggressive Eldrazi creatures while disrupting the opponent's game plan with cards like Chalice of the Void and Thought-Knot Seer. The deck also utilizes powerful lands like Eye of Ugin and Eldrazi Temple to ramp into bigger threats like Reality Smasher. By combining efficient mana acceleration and disruptive creatures, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent and close out the game before they can stabilize.

The deck focuses on using various spells like Reanimate, Entomb, and Animate Dead to quickly bring powerful creatures back from the graveyard, such as Archon of Cruelty and Murktide Regent, for a lethal combo. It also includes disruption spells like Thoughtseize and Force of Will to protect the combo and control the opponent's board. The mana base includes lands like Wasteland and Underground Sea to ensure smooth gameplay and efficient resource management, while cards like Brainstorm and Ponder help dig for key combo pieces. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with powerful reanimated creatures while disrupting their game plan.

This deck focuses on utilizing disruptive spells and efficient creatures to control the pace of the game and pressure the opponent. By combining hand disruption tools like Thoughtseize with counter magic like Daze and Force of Will, along with removal spells like Fatal Push, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while deploying threats like Brazen Borrower, Murktide Regent, and Nethergoyf to close out the game quickly. The mana base is streamlined to support the deck's strategy, with a focus on black and blue sources for casting spells efficiently.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly assemble the Doomsday combo and win the game by using Thassa's Oracle to draw the last card in the deck and win through a Laboratory Maniac effect. The deck includes several mana acceleration cards like Dark Ritual and Lotus Petal to speed up the combo, as well as disruption cards like Thoughtseize and Force of Will to control the game until the combo can be assembled. The deck aims to win the game within a few turns by effectively utilizing card selection and mana resources.

The deck focuses on quickly putting powerful creatures into the graveyard, then bringing them back into play for a game-winning combo. It utilizes cards like Entomb, Reanimate, and Animate Dead to quickly reanimate creatures like Archon of Cruelty and Atraxa, Grand Unifier. The deck also includes disruption elements like Thoughtseize and Force of Will to protect the combo pieces. Overall, the strategy of the deck is to efficiently reanimate creatures while disrupting the opponent's game plan, ultimately overwhelming them with powerful threats.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly fill the graveyard with powerful creatures using cards like Entomb and Thoughtseize, then reanimate them onto the battlefield using spells such as Reanimate and Animate Dead. The deck also includes counterspells like Force of Will and Daze to protect the combo, along with disruption cards like Thoughtseize and Stifle to control the opponent's game plan. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty and Atraxa, Grand Unifier, while maintaining control of the game with a mixture of disruption and protection spells.

The key strategy of this Doomsday combo deck is to quickly manipulate the library in order to win the game using the Doomsday card. By drawing cards and searching through the library with cards like Brainstorm and Ponder, the player can set up their combo and ensure a victory with cards like Thassa's Oracle. The deck also includes disruption elements like Force of Will and Thoughtseize to protect the combo and disrupt the opponent's strategy. Overall, the deck aims to efficiently assemble its combo pieces and win the game in a proactive manner.

This deck focuses on controlling the game through a mix of counterspells, removal, and card draw. It aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while setting up its own win condition. The deck utilizes a variety of colors to provide versatility and answers to different threats. Leyline cards play a key role in boosting the control aspect, while powerful creatures like Scion of Draco can close out the game. The mana base is carefully constructed to support the diverse range of spells in the deck.

The main focus of this deck is to disrupt the opponent's game plan through efficient removal and disruption spells like Fatal Push, Thoughtseize, and Daze. It aims to control the tempo of the game by using counterspells like Force of Will and card selection spells like Ponder and Brainstorm. The creatures in the deck provide additional pressure and threats, such as Murktide Regent and Nethergoyf, while Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student helps to generate card advantage. The mana base is optimized to support the aggressive nature of the deck while also disrupting the opponent's mana base with cards like Wasteland.

The main concept of this UWx Control deck is to control the game by utilizing a combination of counterspells, removal spells, and card draw. The deck aims to slow down the opponent's game plan using cards like Force of Will and Swords to Plowshares, while also generating card advantage through cards like Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student and Brainstorm. The deck also includes threats like Murktide Regent and Thundertrap Trainer to apply pressure on the opponent. The goal is to disrupt the opponent's strategy and out-value them in the long game.

The deck revolves around quickly getting out a powerful creature, such as Emrakul, the Aeons Torn or Atraxa, Grand Unifier, using the "Show and Tell" card to cheat it into play. It also utilizes cards like Sneak Attack and Omniscience to bring out big threats ahead of schedule. The deck also includes a variety of counterspells and cantrips to protect the combo pieces and find the necessary cards to win the game. The focus is on assembling the combo pieces efficiently and disrupting the opponent's plans.

The main objective of this deck is to quickly and efficiently combo off by milling your entire library with cards like Balustrade Spy and Undercity Informer, then utilizing Thassa's Oracle to win the game on the spot. The deck includes a variety of fast mana and card draw spells to help assemble the combo pieces quickly, while also including disruption elements like Thoughtseize and Pact of Negation to protect the combo. The deck aims to go off as early as possible in order to win the game before the opponent has a chance to react.

The main concept of this deck is to maintain tempo and control the board through a combination of efficient threats like Delver of Secrets and Dragon's Rage Channeler, while disrupting the opponent with counterspells like Force of Will and Daze. By utilizing cards like Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning for direct damage, along with the card advantage provided by Brainstorm and Mishra's Bauble, the deck aims to pressure the opponent while quickly closing out the game. Additionally, cards like Murktide Regent provide a powerful late-game threat to seal the victory.

This deck focuses on generating a large amount of mana quickly using cards like Dark Ritual and Lion's Eye Diamond, while also disrupting the opponent's game plan with cards like Duress and Thoughtseize. The goal is to assemble the pieces needed for a powerful combo finish, usually involving cards like Tendrils of Agony or Ad Nauseam to deal a large amount of damage in a single turn. The deck also utilizes cards with the "Wish" mechanic to tutor for specific cards needed in different situations, allowing for flexibility and adaptability in different matchups.
